stories.title: North Wales Police warn of rise in mobile phone contract scams
stories.summary: North Wales Police have warned of a rise in mobile phone contract scams, with fraudsters posing as network providers and offering fake free gifts to steal account and banking details. stories.title: Nightingale House Hospice launches new website with simpler self-referral
stories.summary: Flintshire patients and their families have a simpler route to free hospice care after Nightingale House Hospice in Wrexham launched a redesigned website. The new site has a simpler self-referral process for patients and improved referral pathways for healthcare professionals across the hospice’s catchment area. stories.title: Flintshire Council signs off Green Lane East reversal as 20mph rollback continues
